questions.stem: According to the passage, what did NASA's DART mission accomplish in 2022?
options: It destroyed the Dimorphos asteroid completely
It successfully changed the orbit of the Dimorphos asteroid
It painted the Dimorphos asteroid white to track its path
It used a nuclear weapon to redirect the Dimorphos asteroid
questions.evidence: The effort successfully changed the asteroid’s orbit around a larger space rock.
questions.explanation_ko: DART 임무는 소행성 디모르포스의 궤도를 성공적으로 변경시켰다고 명시되어 있다.

questions.stem: All of the following are mentioned in the passage as possible planetary defense methods EXCEPT:
options: Sending a spacecraft to fly alongside an asteroid using gravity to pull it away
Shooting laser beams from a spacecraft to push an asteroid off course
Building a large physical shield in orbit to block asteroids from reaching Earth
Painting one side of an asteroid white to change its course
questions.evidence: Scientists have also considered painting one side of the asteroid white.
questions.explanation_ko: 본문에는 중력 견인, 레이저, 페인트칠 방법은 언급되지만 궤도 방패 건설은 언급되지 않는다.

questions.stem: What can be inferred from the statement that astronomers expect the odds of impact to keep rising before eventually dropping to zero?
options: The asteroid's path is currently unpredictable and will remain so forever
As more data is collected, scientists gain a clearer picture of the asteroid's actual trajectory
The asteroid is likely to hit Earth with certainty
Space agencies plan to abandon tracking the asteroid soon
questions.evidence: Astronomers have noted that the more data they gather, the odds of a direct asteroid hit are expected to keep rising over time.
questions.explanation_ko: 더 많은 데이터를 얻을수록 궤도가 명확해져 결국 충돌 가능성이 사라진다는 것을 추론할 수 있다.

questions.stem: Why does the author mention the DART mission in the passage?
options: To criticize NASA for failing to protect Earth from asteroids
To provide an example of a planetary defense method that has actually been tested
To explain why nuclear weapons are the best defense option
To argue that gravity tractors are more effective than kinetic impacts
questions.evidence: Only one planetary defense method has been tried against an asteroid.
questions.explanation_ko: DART는 실제로 시도된 유일한 행성 방어 방법의 예시로 언급된다.

questions.stem: In the sentence "He said this is because if a spacecraft only partly destroys an asteroid, it could send smaller pieces of the space rock heading toward Earth," what does the phrase "send smaller pieces" most likely mean in this context?
options: Communicate information about the asteroid
Launch replacement spacecraft toward Earth
Cause fragments of the asteroid to travel toward Earth
Deliver samples of the asteroid to scientists
questions.evidence: He said this is because if a spacecraft only partly destroys an asteroid, it could send smaller pieces of the space rock heading toward Earth.
questions.explanation_ko: 소행성이 완전히 파괴되지 않으면 그 파편들이 지구를 향해 날아갈 수 있다는 의미이다.

blanks.sentence_ko: 모이슬은 확률이 100퍼센트까지 올라가는 드문 경우라도 세계는 '무방비 상태가 아니다'라고 말했다.

blanks.expression: take care not to overdo it
eject a continuous flow of atoms
blanks.sentence_ko: 모이슬은 또 다른 비접촉 방식은 소행성 근처에 우주선을 배치해 원자의 지속적인 흐름을 방출하여 소행성을 궤도에서 밀어내는 것이라고 말했다.

key_points: NASA estimated a small but historically high probability that asteroid 2024 YR4 could hit Earth in 2032
Space agency officials say humanity now has multiple potential methods to defend against asteroid strikes
The only tested method so far is NASA's DART mission, which changed an asteroid's orbit by crashing a spacecraft into it
Other proposed methods include gravity tractors, ejecting atoms to push asteroids off course, painting asteroids white, using lasers, and nuclear weapons
Experts warn that partially destroying an asteroid could create dangerous fragments heading toward Earth
Even if the asteroid's impact probability rises, there is still time to evacuate the area likely to be affected
main_idea: Although there is a small but notable chance that asteroid 2024 YR4 could strike Earth in 2032, scientists have developed and are considering several methods to protect the planet from such a threat.
restate_sentence: He said this is because if a spacecraft only partly destroys an asteroid, it could send smaller pieces of the space rock heading toward Earth.
